description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the GPU Memory in gigabytes (GB) required by various language model fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the categorical methods, with labels rotated diagonally: "Full FT", "MTL-FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "QLoRA", and "Ours". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "GPU Memory (GB)", using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to approximately 80, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60) and corresponding light gray horizontal grid lines. There are six vertical bars corresponding to each category. The first five bars are colored orange, while the final bar is colored green. The "Full FT" bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 73 GB. This is followed by "MTL-FT" at roughly 39 GB. The "TAG" and "LoRA" bars are nearly identical in height, both indicating approximately 21 GB. The "QLoRA" bar is the shortest, showing about 13 GB. Finally, the "Ours" bar is approximately 21 GB. The categories generally follow a descending trend in memory usage from left to right, with the exception of the final category. The "Ours" category is visually emphasized; its bar is uniquely colored green, and its corresponding horizontal axis label is bolded.
